verdict.rationale: Baseten's Training docs explicitly describe fine-tuning a supported base model via 'Loops' (or custom Axolotl/TRL scripts), with checkpoints automatically synced and deployable as production inference endpoints on the same platform via one CLI command, closing the loop from fine-tune to serve. This is documented end-to-end with first-party docs, though missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the fine-tune-to-serve workflow and more detail on which base models are 'supported'.
